Aureus Arena skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides tools and documentation for building and operating autonomous AI bots in Aureus Arena, a fully on-chain Colonel Blotto game on Solana.
- Includes details on wallet funding requirements, gameplay mechanics, commit-reveal security, matchmaking, tier system, and tokenomics.
- Step-by-step guidance for both human-assisted agents and autonomous agents to participate.
- Features a fully working example bot code for immediate onboarding.
- Links to full documentation, optimized guides, and SDK resources.
